Plot quality-control distributions

Source: R/qc_runner.R
plot_qc.Rd

Plot distributions of the main spot-level and gene-level QC metrics stored in a SpatialExperiment object.

Usage

plot_qc(spe, bins = 45, show_density = TRUE, theme_name = "classic")

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment object containing QC metrics generated by `add_qcs()`.

bins

Number of histogram bins. Default is 45.

show_density

Logical. If TRUE, density curves are added to the histograms.

theme_name

Plot theme. One of `"classic"`, `"bw"`, `"minimal"`, or `"gray"`.

Value

A list containing plotting data, individual plots, and the combined plot.

Details

The function can be used before or after filtering.

Examples

data(spe_example)

spe_qc <- add_qcs(
  spe_example,
  assay_name = "counts",
  mito_pattern = "^MT-"
)

p_qc <- plot_qc(
  spe_qc,
  bins = 45,
  show_density = TRUE,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

p_qc$plot
